confidence_notes: FX is the RBA rate for 18 Nov 2026 found via search. I ran one price search for Ushuaia. It gave crowdsourced figures that disagreed with each other and may be outdated, given Argentina's currency volatility. Ushuaia is a remote tourist hub and costs more than the rest of Argentina, so I leaned toward the higher figures. Cocktail and wine are set from their usual relationship to beer, not from direct data. Accommodation figures are holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not from listings. The July 2026 reference window is peak-to-shoulder winter season.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Ushuaia aggregated price indexes, adjusted upward toward Patagonian tourist-town pricing such as El Calafate and Bariloche.
